crossRefs.note: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore have my words been rash.
He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
“Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and…
One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is…
“Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on…
“I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned…
His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three…
It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the…
Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike…

translations.web: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,
